exposure: causes of maternal morbidity (hemorrhage, hypertensive disorders, sepsis, cardiovascular diseases)
cohort: The study included 449 women with severe maternal outcomes admitted to the Intensive Care Unit.
finding: The maternal near miss mortality ratio was 11:1, mortality index 8.68%, with 1.58% severe maternal outcomes resulting in 39 maternal deaths, primarily due to eclampsia, hemorrhage, and sepsis.
mod_finding: Operative delivery was a statistically significantly more common mode of delivery in severe maternal outcomes (66.6%) and maternal deaths (33.3%).
